name: C-PASA High School Camp (Cargill-Purdue Agriculture & STEM Academy)
org: Purdue University College of Agriculture, Office of Academic Programs
what_you_do: Spend a week living on Purdue's campus. You do hands-on work in agriculture and STEM. You visit research sites and labs. You tour agriculture companies. You meet Purdue students and faculty. You see what college life is like.
who_can_apply: Students going into grades 9 to 12. No other rule is stated on the camp page.
pay_detail: Cost not stated on the camp page. Summer College for High School Students sets the price (see the Purdue Summer College card).
deadline_text: The 2026 camp ran July 12 to 17, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted on the camp page.
how_to_apply: Apply through Purdue's Summer College for High School Students (the camp page says the 2026 application was there). Questions: purdueag@purdue.edu.
notes: This is a camp, not a job, and it costs money. The Purdue ag summer programs index page describes the high school camp as a two-week experience. The camp page itself says one week. Confirm the length with purdueag@purdue.edu.
